svg.aria-label: Quest walkthrough in four steps: paste the install sentence into Claude Code, turn on Developer mode and Load unpacked in the browser, start a Tiny Lesson in Little Language Lessons, then see the lesson saved and sent to your agent. A drawn illustration.

g.text: What would you like to do today?
✓ Server added. Start a new session and say “Connect LangCoach to Little Language Lessons”.
Paste one sentence into Claude Code
Your agent sets up the server for you
Little Language Lessons, now with a memory.
Click Load unpacked, then paste the folder path your agent gave you
LangCoach is on. Open Little Language Lessons next.
Open Little Language Lessons and pick a lesson
Press Start and study as usual
LangCoach saves the lesson and sends it to your agent
Say “show my dashboard” any time to see your progress
